newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine property stocks index up 3.12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine property stocks index up 3.12 pct.

text.p: The Philippine property sector, which was battered by fears of a crash in prices due to a glut in the past several days, rebounded in early Thursday trade on bargain hunting.

"I think the selling was overdone. Investors are buying back Megaworld Property Holdings Inc and Empire East Land Holdings Inc because they are now selling at very cheap levels," said analyst Russel Ong at Anscor Hagedorn Securities Inc.
Empire East was up 10.34 percent, or by 60 centavos, to 6.40 pesos while its parent Megaworld was up 11.11 percent, or by 70 centavos, to seven pesos.
Some 19.284 million shares of Empire East changed hands while 2.018 million shares of Megaworld were traded.
